key.name: shortcut-primary
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to toggle Quick Light search modal.

key.name: shortcut-secondary
key.description: Optional alternate keyboard shortcut to toggle Quick Light.

key.name: popup-at-cursor
key.description: Display the spotlight search box on the monitor containing the mouse pointer.

key.name: preferred-monitor
key.description: Index of preferred monitor to show the search window (0 for primary display).

key.name: monitor-count
key.description: Number of monitors detected by Quick Light.

key.name: show-panel-indicator
key.description: Display an icon in the top GNOME panel to open Quick Light.

key.name: indicator-color
key.description: RGBA color of the status bar indicator icon.

key.name: window-width-scale
key.description: Scaling factor to adjust the width of the search popup window.

key.name: window-height-scale
key.description: Scaling factor to adjust the height of the search popup window.

key.name: border-radius
key.description: Corner curvature radius for the spotlight modal in pixels.

key.name: border-thickness
key.description: Border width in pixels (0 for borderless).

key.name: border-color
key.description: RGBA color of the spotlight window border.

key.name: background-color
key.description: RGBA color and opacity of the spotlight window backdrop.

key.name: text-color
key.description: Custom RGBA text color. Set alpha to 0 for automatic luminance-based coloring.

key.name: entry-font-size
key.description: Font size in points for the search entry field.

key.name: results-font-size
key.description: Font size in points for the search result items.

key.name: enable-animations
key.description: Animate opacity and scale when displaying or closing the search popup.

key.name: animation-duration
key.description: Duration of the ease animation in milliseconds.

key.name: enable-web-search
key.description: Search keywords on Google directly from the spotlight search modal.

key.name: web-search-mode
key.description: 0: Search Google when no search result matches (Smart Fallback), 1: Search Google with Shift+Enter only, 2: Always search Google on Enter

key.name: web-search-engine-url
key.description: URL template with %s for the query parameter.

key.name: search-prefixes
key.summary: Custom search prefixes and web bangs
key.description: JSON array of custom search prefix shortcuts and their target URL templates.
